integrity_gates.rule: record HMLR publication date, exact Lambeth GML locator, immutable source digest and canonical row binding
capabilities must advertise the exact EA DTM 1m coverage; reject DSM, WMS, WMTS, hillshade or alternate resolution
derive subset axis labels and order from service metadata or coverage description; never assume or hardcode
derive finite native EPSG:27700 bounds from the exact parcel geometry; require low < high on each axis
record HTTP status, content type, byte length and digest; reject XML/HTML/service-exception responses
verify EPSG:27700 and approximately 1m ground cells before sampling; reject coarse or mismatched coverage
apply exact polygon mask, honour nodata metadata and require at least four finite in-polygon cells
seal capabilities, request, response, local acceptance, publish manifest and remote readback SHA-256 values

fail_closed_examples.reason: portable execution host heartbeat is stale
publication date, locator or source digest changed after binding
official identifier is absent or not exactly unique
selected service resource is not the exact EA DTM 1m coverage
axis labels or subset order cannot be proven from service metadata
subset bounds are non-finite, inverted or outside the parcel-derived envelope
response is an XML, HTML or OGC exception document
content type, byte count or response digest is missing or unexpected
raster is not EPSG:27700 or is materially coarser than 1m
masked parcel contains no finite elevation cells
fewer than four finite in-polygon cells remain
any capabilities, request, response, manifest or remote-readback seal changed
